title: AI Emulation of Stochastic Sudden Stratospheric Warming with Interpretable Latent Structure
abstract: arXiv:2610.02069v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rare weather regime transitions pose a challenge for data-driven modeling due to class imbalance. In this study, we develop a probabilistic deep learning emulator for a prototypical system with regime transitions, the stochastic Holton--Mass model of stratospheric variability, and analyze the structure of its learned latent space. The Holton--Mass model exhibits two metastable regimes, a strong and a weak polar vortex, maintained by nonlinear wave--mean flow interactions, with weak stochastic forcing intermittently triggering rare transitions between these regimes that qualitatively represent SSW events. We employ a ResNet-inspired Conditional Variational Autoencoder with six-layer encoder and decoder layers and explicit current-state conditioning to model the distribution of the system's state at the next time step (one day). The emulator accurately reproduces short-term dynamics, steady-state probability distributions, regime persist

translated_title: 基于可解释潜在结构的平流层爆发性增温随机过程的AI模拟
translated_abstract: 稀有天气流型转变由于类别不平衡问题对数据驱动建模构成了挑战。在本研究中，我们为一个具有流型转变的原型系统——平流层变率的随机Holton-Mass模型——开发了一个概率深度学习仿真器，并分析了其学习到的潜在空间结构。Holton-Mass模型表现出两个亚稳态流型，即强极涡和弱极涡，由非线性波-平均流相互作用维持，而弱随机强迫会间歇性地触发这两个流型之间的稀有转变，这些转变在定性上代表了平流层爆发性增温（SSW）事件。我们采用受ResNet启发的条件变分自编码器（Conditional Variational Autoencoder），包含六层编码器和六层解码器，并具有显式的当前状态条件化，用于建模系统在下一时间步（一天）的状态分布。该仿真器准确再现了短期动力学、稳态概率分布以及流型持续性
tldr: 本研究开发了一个基于条件变分自编码器的概率深度学习仿真器，用于模拟具有稀有流型转变的随机Holton-Mass平流层模型，该模型能准确再现短期动力学、稳态分布和流型持续性，且其学习到的潜在空间具有可解释的结构。
en_tdlr: This study develops a probabilistic deep learning emulator based on a Conditional Variational Autoencoder for the stochastic Holton-Mass model with rare regime transitions, accurately reproducing short-term dynamics, steady-state distributions, and regime persistence, while exhibiting an interpretable latent space structure.
